pack.name: Healthcare
pack.summary: Shift debriefs, reflective practice and CPD for patient-facing roles — never patient records.

templates.name: Shift debrief
templates.summary: How the shift went, in your own terms — never a patient record.

fields.label: Concerns
fields.prompt: What’s worth flagging, in general terms — never a patient’s name or details?

templates.name: Reflective account
templates.summary: Gibbs’ Reflective Cycle, the format the NMC and HCPC both ask for.

fields.label: Description
fields.prompt: What happened? (Keep it general — no identifying details.)

fields.label: Feelings
fields.prompt: What were you thinking and feeling at the time, and since?

fields.label: Evaluation
fields.prompt: What was good and bad about the experience?

fields.label: Action plan
fields.prompt: What will you do differently next time?

templates.name: Supervision prep
templates.summary: What you want to raise in your next reflective discussion or clinical supervision.

fields.label: Topics
fields.prompt: What do you want to discuss?

fields.label: Notes
fields.prompt: What came out of the discussion?
